name: Game Meat
description: Something shot in the treeline and carried home wrapped in a coat. It will not keep.

name: Roast Game
description: Turned over the coals until the outside went dark. The best thing anyone has eaten in weeks.

name: Fresh Fish
description: Pulled out of the river an hour ago and already going soft at the gills.

name: Grilled Fish
description: Split, salted with whatever was to hand, laid straight on the grate.

name: Foraged Roots
description: Dug out of a verge and knocked clean against a boot. Bitter, and a great deal better hot.

name: Roasted Roots
description: Buried in the ash and forgotten about for the right length of time.

name: Dried Beans
description: A sack of them, hard as gravel. Nobody is eating these until somebody boils them.

name: Stewed Beans
description: Soaked all afternoon and simmered until they gave up. Dull, hot and filling.

name: Raw Dough
description: Flour, water and a long argument with a table. Sticky and inedible as it stands.

name: Flatbread
description: Slapped onto a hot stone and turned once. Blistered, smoky, and gone in a minute.

name: Offal
description: The parts nobody used to take home. Everybody takes them home now.

name: Fried Offal
description: Cooked hard in its own fat, which is the only way it is going to be eaten.

name: Foraged Grubs
description: Turned up under a rotten log. Protein is protein, and nobody has to watch.

name: Roasted Grubs
description: Dry-roasted on a tin lid until they stopped looking like themselves.

name: Salted Strips
description: Meat cut thin and rubbed with road salt, waiting on somebody to keep a low fire going all night.

name: Cured Meat
description: Packed in salt and hung by the flue for as long as anybody could stand to wait. It keeps.

name: Windfall Fruit
description: Bruised fruit off the grass under somebody's tree, jarred up with sugar or thrown out within the week.

name: Jar of Preserves
description: Boiled down, sealed hot, and set on the shelf against a month nobody wants to think about.

name: Camp Stove
description: A folding burner with a part-full cylinder screwed to it. It boils a pan without lighting up the street.

name: Billy Can
description: A dented steel pot with a wire handle. Set it over any flame and what comes out is safe to drink.

name: Pump Filter
description: A hiker's hand pump with a ceramic cartridge. It strains a bottle clean and asks for no fire at all.

name: Purification Tablets
description: A foil strip of chlorine tablets. Drop one in, wait, and put up with the taste.

name: Canteen of Standing Water
description: A steel canteen somebody filled and then had a worse day. It will do, unless it doesn't.

name: Canteen of Clean Water
description: A steel canteen of water somebody made safe, and nobody is going to waste.
